g.text: Newton, light as fast particles: sideways kick ≈ force × time near the Sun ≈ (GMm/b²)(2b/c), so θ = 2GM/(bc²) = 0.87″ at the limb.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #888888

g.text: Einstein, curved space and time together: exactly twice that, 1.75″. Measured 1919: 1.6 to 2.0″. Radio, 2004: 1.7499 ± 0.0003″.
